verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no product-native way for users to create automations, rules, scheduled jobs, or agent workflows that run on their own in the background. The closest items do not qualify. Server-to-server OAuth client credentials are a developer building block a user could script against. Configuring payments to appear pre-categorized and receiving AI alerts are adjacent features, not user-defined autonomous automations. Batch payments are a user-initiated one-off action, not a recurring schedule.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
